23.reason: A set of workflow refinements: sync-store writes under developer credentials, a console view of identity data, and easier role setup.

104.reason: The existing deployment operation gains a further target class, customer-hosted machines, with a per-update fee as supporting detail.

120.reason: Functions become one more subscription endpoint type alongside the delivery targets the notification service already had.

122.reason: GA alone adds nothing; the explicit addition is a synchronous call path from client apps carrying identity and device context.

160.reason: The existing Chef-based management service extends to a further operating system platform.

177.reason: The region launch is outside scale; the remaining change is a wider list of interface languages picked up from client settings.

186.reason: New attach and detach calls let a live group change its load balancers, which was not possible after creation before.

200.reason: Removing outdated task definition revisions is a distinct new operation; sorting and run-time variable overrides are smaller refinements.

231.reason: First monitoring integration for the desktop service, exposing health and connection metrics with alarming where none existed.

241.reason: Beyond version bumps, the release reworks packaging and adds a direct application-settings interface at cluster creation in place of bootstrap scripts.

246.reason: First storage usage metrics with alarming for buckets, plus a deletion event type and name-based notification filters.

283.reason: An SDK for an additional app framework exits preview with no new functions listed, so the change is platform compatibility.

297.reason: Custom scalar functions written in Python become callable from SQL, a distinct capability but not a whole new subsystem.

365.reason: One more dataset joins the public data catalogue; no service function changes.

366.reason: A client-side wrapper extends existing send and receive to much larger bodies by parking the payload in object storage.

386.reason: The existing real-device test operation extends to one more application type.

388.reason: SDK reaches production status with convenience helpers layered over existing calls, such as paging, waiting and response querying.

420.reason: Access-control refinements (tag conditions in policies, default grants for future objects) plus one more load compression format.

422.reason: The existing storage backend plugin is updated to support a newer version of the graph engine.

425.reason: Two starter templates are added to the existing console template catalogue; the service itself gains no new function.

431.reason: The region launch is outside scale; cross-account package sharing and package deletion are new management operations.

435.reason: A new distribution setting makes the CDN compress eligible responses itself, extending existing content delivery behaviour.

443.reason: GA alone is not a new product here; the stated additions are an iOS SDK target and dual-stack addressing on the device endpoint.
